text:
matt: Quick status — kernel PR merged into a draft branch: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/482. Need owners for canary + KV warmup. Perf harness shows ~6% throughput regression on long sequences when continuous batching is enabled. p50 before: 42ms -> after: 48ms. Any objections to triaging this in this thread?

jia: I ran the perf job (cmd below) against p4d/seq=2048, batch=true. Seeing KV lock contention spikes around step 1200.
```
./bench --model llama2 --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --batching=continuous --backend=p4d
```
Logs: `kv_lock_wait_ms` jumps from ~2ms -> ~18ms.

priya: I can take the kernel canary and the PR review. Can you post the exact unit tests and canary steps I should run? Also @sam should be looped for the microkernel changes.

aj: I'll own KV warmup/backfill. If kv-lock is the issue we might need growth windows on cache eviction. Need infra changes for warmup memory reservation. cc @sophia for autoscaler impacts.

sophia: FYI ops: I rolled the batch-window config down yesterday (window_ms=5 -> 10) to reduce jitter. That may interplay with batching windows; I'll revert if it helps. Config snippet:
```
batching:
  window_ms: 5
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
```

sam: I'll review the PR tonight. Quick ask: add a flag to disable continuous batching per-route so we can A/B test kernel vs no-kernel paths.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime-canary-2026-03-18T22:00Z for pr/482. See deploy: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/482 :rocket:

matt: Ownership summary: kernel canary -> priya; kv warmup/backfill -> aj; autoscaler/ops -> sophia; PR review -> sam. Plan: priya runs canary + captures detailed flamegraphs, aj runs KV warmup experiments, sam lands the AB flag, sophia watches autoscaler metrics during canary. Please update the linked tickets: RW-1345 (kernel regression), RW-1346 (kv-warmup). I'll open short follow-up tickets for measurement gaps. :thumbsup:

priya: Got it — starting canary checklist now, will post results under RW-1345 as comments. Expect initial numbers in ~45m.

aj: I'll start a small infra branch to provision warmup memory and run one backfill job. Will post benchmark artifacts.

sophia: I'll revert window_ms to 10 for the canary window and monitor. If anything spikes I'll pause the canary.

sam: Reviewing PR and will add the per-route batching toggle. Ping me if you want the AB group names.

matt: Awesome. If anyone hits a blocker DM me. Otherwise we'll reconvene async after canary artifacts land.
